owners.name: Digital channels
owners.description: Owns the app assessment and saved application draft.

owners.name: Business lending
owners.description: Owns adviser handoff and the lending decision.

capabilities.name: Shared application context
capabilities.description: Carry cash-flow assessment, draft, documents and consent between app and adviser.

journeys.title: Freelancer secures a cash-flow buffer
journeys.goal: Cover a temporary cash shortfall without repeating information across channels.
journeys.description: Fictional discovery hypothesis. Persona: a solo freelancer with a late invoice and bills due next week. If a cash-flow assessment, application draft and documents carry from mobile app to adviser, fewer customers will restart or abandon the application. Validate with interviews and a usability pilot. Service coverage, friction points and experience-curve values are assumptions, not observed bank capabilities or measured customer evidence.
journeys.baseline: Unmeasured: establish completion, repeated fields and time-to-decision.
journeys.targetMetric: Pilot hypothesis: +20 pp completion; 0 repeated fields; decision within 1 working day.

customer: A client invoice is late. Bills are due next week; check whether the balance will run out.
Compare total cost, eligibility and repayment risk before choosing a buffer.
Start an application in the app; an adviser asks for the same income and invoices again.
Receive a decision, draw the buffer and track repayment without missing bills.

services.name: Cash-flow assessment
services.description: Estimate the next 30 days of cash inflows and bills. Current coverage is an assumption to investigate.

services.name: Cash-buffer application
services.description: Apply for a temporary lending buffer. Assumed current app webview loses the assessment when moving to an adviser.

notes.now: Assumption: customer checks the balance, then forecasts bills in a spreadsheet.
notes.target: Proposed: the forecast warns early and is saved with customer consent.

steps.textTarget: See a cash-gap warning and save the assessment

notes.now: Assumption: the website comparison does not know the app assessment.
notes.target: Proposed: comparisons reuse the assessment; confirm understanding of cost and risk.

steps.textTarget: Compare options using the saved cash-flow assessment

steps.text: Start the application and re-enter finances

notes.now: Assumption: a webview starts a new form and loses comparison context.
notes.target: Proposed: prefill the application. Pilot repeated fields and abandonment.

steps.textTarget: Continue a prefilled application in the app

steps.text: Adviser asks for income and invoices again

notes.now: Assumption: adviser cannot see the app draft or documents. Second restart.
notes.target: Proposed: adviser reads the same draft and documents; customer fills only gaps.

steps.textTarget: Adviser opens the same draft and verifies missing evidence

steps.text: Read the lending decision and activate the buffer

notes.now: Assumption: customer returns to internet banking after the adviser decision.
notes.target: Proposed: decision and repayment terms return to the saved digital journey.

steps.textTarget: Receive a clear decision and repayment plan in the same journey

steps.text: Track the repayment dates in the app

notes.now: Assumption: repayment information is available but separate from the cash forecast.
notes.target: Proposed: forecast refreshes after repayments; measure missed-bill risk.

steps.textTarget: See repayment reminders and a refreshed cash forecast

frictions.title: Application restarts in an app webview
frictions.now: Assumption: assessment and comparison inputs are not carried into the application. Verify in customer interviews.
frictions.recommendation: Use a prefilled app application that preserves the assessment, documents and consent.

frictions.title: Adviser cannot see the saved application
frictions.now: Assumption: customer repeats income and invoice details and uploads the same evidence a second time.
frictions.recommendation: Let the adviser open the same draft, check only missing evidence and hand back a clear next step.
